page_title: Aster — 原生 macOS 终端工作区

summary.name: Aster
summary.one_liner: Aster is a free, open-source native macOS terminal workspace built on the Ghostty terminal engine, combining split panes, a file preview pane, AI agent session tracking, and local shell completion in one AppKit window.
use_cases: run terminal sessions alongside file and markdown previews
monitor AI coding agent sessions like Claude Code or Codex
get command and path autocompletion offline
work on remote Linux servers or OrbStack VMs from a native Mac app
save and restore a full terminal workspace layout
summary.what_it_does: Aster is a native macOS app (AppKit) that embeds a Ghostty-based terminal with recursive split panes. A File Pane previews source code, Markdown, images, PDF, diff and hex in the same window. It auto-titles and shows run status for Claude Code and Codex sessions, and includes local command completion using 714 Fig command specs plus file and alias candidates. Remote terminals and layouts can run in a background service on Linux servers or OrbStack VMs over SSH, and a workspace can be exported to a .asterrecipe file and restored on launch.
notable: Ghostty terminal core with recursive split panes and a file preview pane in one AppKit window
714 Fig command specs for local, privacy-preserving autocompletion; no data leaves the machine
Tracks Claude Code and Codex agent session titles and run status; transcripts viewable in File Pane
Remote terminals persist in a background service on Linux servers or OrbStack VMs
caveats: Current release ships only Apple silicon (arm64) builds; Intel Macs cannot run it
Network features such as crash reporting are off by default and must be enabled manually in settings
